stack: Vite + React 18 + TypeScript + React Router + Tailwind CSS 3 + Framer Motion + marked
featurePolicy: freeze — no features added or removed; 1:1 parity with prototype
featuresPreserved: Header: logo ScribeAI + Live AI Coach badge + theme toggle (localStorage) + Clear All Data
API Settings: Base URL, API Key, Model select, Refresh (/models), Save Settings, Test (/chat/completions)
Task/Prompt: textarea, Save prompt, Load saved dropdown (persisted array)
Draft editor: serif textarea, placeholder, word count, char count, read time, live indicator, save status, Import .txt/.md, auto-save 600ms, localStorage
Live Critique: Listening/Reviewing.../Live/Error badges, pulse animation, empty state, streaming markdown via marked, SSE parsing, AbortController, fingerprint dedupe, 8-word minimum, 1.5s debounce
Toasts, dark/light CSS variables, 3-column layout (280px 1fr 340px) responsive

routes./: Landing — open-source, animated, no fake pricing
routes./app: Studio — production studio with responsive stacked/mobile tabs

branding.source: assets/Icon/ (logo.png light, logo_dark.png dark, icon.png mark — transparent PNGs)
branding.usage: theme-aware header logo, PNG favicon + apple-touch-icon, webmanifest icons, OG/Twitter image, README header (<picture> with dark/light source)

skillsApplied.hallmark: strict — no AI slop phrases; direct human copy; natural cadence
skillsApplied.frontend-design (anthropic): strict — bold The Editor's Desk aesthetic (editorial broadsheet: mono marginalia, hairline rules, pencil marks, block caret glyph), avoids generic purple gradients, emoji icon tiles and system fonts
skillsApplied.ponytail: strict — minimal abstraction, no over-engineered contexts, explicit timeouts/abort, flat file structure
skillsApplied.magicui: strict — Marquee, ShimmerButton, DotPattern, BlurFade, BorderBeam vendored as source under MIT; full repo cloned to /magicui per request; attribution in README and component headers

designTokens.aesthetic: The Editor's Desk (editorial broadsheet on the Solar Workshop palette)

build.bundle: 442.28 kB (139.40 kB gzip) incl. framer-motion; css 23.12 kB

responsiveness: desktop 300px|1fr|380px grid; lg:hidden tabs Write/Critique; settings collapsible drawer; independent scroll on desktop, natural on mobile
a11y: label associations, aria-labels on icon buttons, keyboard-focusable controls, color contrast via CSS variables
notes: Prototype preserved as ai_guided_writing.html for audit. MagicUI repo at /magicui is reference only; its node_modules is gitignored.
